facts.title: Release rarity
facts.text: World Class Demon King flow announced.

history.title: Flow balance and fixes
history.text: Numerous flow buffs and nerfs. Magician Flow moved to Legendary; Emperor cooldown reduction changed from 33% to 20%. Infinite Awakening added to PS+.

history.title: Rivals chemical reaction and Demon King
history.text: Rivals chemistry at defending kickoff when both centre forwards use NEL Isagi and NEL Rin; World Class Demon King flow introduced.
